name: Liliana Vess
title: The Dreadhorde General
role: Necromancer forced to command Bolas's Eternal army
summary: A planeswalker whose defiance of Bolas changed the battle and led to Gideon's sacrifice.
biography: Liliana pursued freedom from supernatural bargains but became bound to the Elder Dragon Nicol Bolas.
On Ravnica she commanded the Dreadhorde while knowing that Bolas's hold on her could kill her if she disobeyed.
She turned the Eternals against Bolas; Gideon absorbed the lethal consequence of her rebellion, leaving her alive with a difficult legacy.

Before the War of the Spark, Liliana traveled to Innistrad seeking Griselbrand, one of the demons to whom she had promised her service. The Chain Veil increased her necromantic power even as it introduced a different, dangerous dependency.

At Thraben Cathedral, Liliana threatened the cathars under Thalia's command until Thalia broke the Helvault. The rupture freed Griselbrand and Avacyn; Liliana's intention was to confront her creditor rather than to restore the archangel or reform Innistrad's church.

This earlier episode helps explain her later resistance to magical obligation without treating it as an early version of the War of the Spark. Her conflict with Bolas, command of the Dreadhorde, and Gideon's sacrifice belong to a subsequent crisis on Ravnica.

featuredCard.significance: Liliana's contested command of the Eternal army during the invasion.
